method: Places are clock ranks within each of the 202 start-screened editions with at least 1,000 finishes (4,083,011 finishes), compared at 20K, 25K, 30K, 35K, 40K and the finish: the share that gained places in all five sections against the share that lost places in all five, as the median over editions. In every section after 20K the typical edition has most finishes gaining places (57–61%) while a minority lose many, so steady gainers can outnumber steady losers. Outside the editions where recorded gender is incomplete, men's finishes 27% against 17%, women's 40% against 7%.
